title: Add a poll to this deck
subtitle: Two slides that share one question: where people vote, and what they chose
bullets: A poll slide shows the options; each browser votes once and may change its vote
A results slide draws the count, live
The two share an id and the list of options
task: Say this. The slide ticks when both slides are in the deck.
prompt: In the deck tutorial-agents, add a poll slide with the id my-poll that asks which editor the audience writes in, with four options, and a results slide with the id my-poll-results for the same poll. Put both right after the slide task-poll.
whenDone: Go to the next slide in both live windows, vote in each, then look at the results slide.
